vocabulary.meaning_en: to speak words; we use it to repeat exactly what someone said
to give someone information, instructions or orders
vocabulary.note_ar: الماضي والتصريف الثالث: told. غالبًا يتبعها شخص: tell me
vocabulary.note_en: Past and past participle: told. Usually followed by a person: tell me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to notice a sound with your ears without trying (passive)
vocabulary.example: Did you hear the door close?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay attention to a sound on purpose (active)
vocabulary.note_ar: حرف t صامت: /ˈlɪsn/، ونقول listen to someone
vocabulary.note_en: The t is silent: /ˈlɪsn/. We say "listen to someone".

vocabulary.example: Can you give me some information about the course?

vocabulary.meaning_en: words that tell you how to do something
vocabulary.example: Read the instructions before you start.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a command; words that tell you to do something
vocabulary.example: The officer gave an order to stop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: it happens to you; you don't try
to give all your attention to something
You already know what happens next / what to do.
vocabulary.meaning_ar: أنت تعرف ما سيحدث / ما عليك فعله.
vocabulary.example: It's quiz time. You know the drill.

fine_lines.title: say vs tell
fine_lines.explanation_ar: say لتكرار كلام شخص كما هو، ولا يأتي بعدها الشخص مباشرة (say to me وليس say me). tell لإعطاء معلومات أو تعليمات أو أوامر، ويأتي بعدها الشخص: tell me.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Say repeats exactly what someone said, and it is not followed directly by a person (say to me, not say me). Tell gives information, instructions or orders, and is followed by a person: tell me.

examples.sentence: What did he say? He said he was happy.
Tell me where you were last night.
She told me to go home.

fine_lines.title: hear vs listen
fine_lines.explanation_ar: listen فعل نشط: تركّز على صوت بقصد (في الصف تستمع للمعلم). hear فعل غير مقصود: الصوت يصل إليك وأنت لا تركّز (تسمع طائرًا أو باب سيارة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Listen is active: you focus on a sound on purpose (in class you listen to the teacher). Hear is passive: the sound just comes to you (you hear a bird or a car door).

examples.sentence: I'm listening to you. Go on.
Did you hear the bird outside?

expressions.example: He wants to quit? Did he really say that?
Tell me about your new job.

expressions.meaning_en: Said by a parent or boss when you didn't follow their order.
expressions.example: Your room is a mess again. What did I tell you?
I just explained it. Were you listening?

expressions.meaning_en: Checking if the sound reached someone.
expressions.example: Dinner is ready! Did you hear me?
Phones off, books open. You know the drill.

grammar.title: Say: repeat the words
grammar.explanation_ar: say (said) + الكلام المنقول. إذا أردت ذكر الشخص استخدم to: He said to me... . لا نقول He said me.
grammar.explanation_en: say (said) + the words. To mention the person, use to: He said to me... . Never "He said me".
examples: What did he say to you?

grammar.title: Tell: information, instructions, orders
grammar.explanation_ar: tell + شخص + معلومة: Tell me your name. tell + شخص + how/where + ...: للتعليمات. tell + شخص + to + المصدر: للأوامر.
grammar.explanation_en: tell + person + information: Tell me your name. tell + person + how/where...: instructions. tell + person + to + base verb: orders.
examples: He told me about his holiday. (information)
Can you tell me how to get to the station? (instructions)
My father told me to come home early. (order)

grammar.title: Listen (active) vs hear (passive)
grammar.explanation_ar: listen to + شيء: تركيز مقصود. hear + شيء: يصل الصوت إليك. نقول listen to the news و hear a noise.
grammar.explanation_en: listen to + something: focus on purpose. hear + something: the sound reaches you. We say listen to the news, hear a noise.
examples: I listen to the news every morning.
I heard a strange noise last night.
Listen! Can you hear the rain?

questions.question: Can you ___ me where the bank is?
questions.explanation_ar: نطلب معلومات وبعدها شخص: tell me.
questions.explanation_en: We want information, followed by a person: tell me.

questions.question: What did he ___? He ___ he was sorry.
questions.explanation_en: We repeat his exact words: say/said.

questions.question: In class, you should ___ to the teacher.
Did you ___ that loud noise outside?
questions.explanation_ar: صوت وصل إليك بدون قصد: hear.
questions.explanation_en: A sound came to you: hear.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
choices: She told to me the answer.

questions.question: My boss ___ me to finish the report today. (an order)
questions.explanation_en: Orders: tell someone to do something.

questions.question: Which word is NOT correct? "Read the ___ before you use the machine."
questions.explanation_ar: information غير معدودة: لا نقول informations.
